Auxetic materials with negative Poisson's ratio, pentamode lattices, and origami-inspired metamaterials are demonstrated. Acoustic cloaks redirect sound. Physical and engineering constraints on Programmable Mechanical Metamaterials.

Tunable range is limited in most designs. Manufacturing complex lattices at scale is expensive. Fatigue and durability of intricate structures are concerns.

Scale analysis across 3 quantities spans 10 orders of magnitude; the dominant scale separation is lattice feature size vs fatigue cycles tested at 10 orders of magnitude (fatigue cycles tested larger). Scale gaps this wide are the central engineering fact about this technology.
